result.title: Optimising VLM Harnesses to Localise Errors in Generated Videos
result.summary: Identifying subtle errors in generated videos is an important step toward automated video generation, where errors must be detected to assess and refine generated clips. Recent work shows that pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) can localise such errors, but their effectiveness depends strongly on the workflow used: choices about which frames to inspect, which tools and model calls to make, and how to combine predictions can lead to substantially different results. We study VLM harnesses for video error localisation. Instead of relying on manually designed harnesses, we propose Harness Search and Merge (HSM), an algorithm that automatically constructs them by searching over executable evaluation programs. An LLM orchestrator refines candidate harnesses independently on random training subsets, records findings in a memory, and constructively merges complementary candidates. We evaluate HSM on Spotlight, a recently proposed benchmark for localising errors in generated videos. HSM achieves 0.234 +- 0.012 F1, exceeding the strongest benchmark strategy (0.173 +- 0.016), and retains its lead on an unseen video generator (0.213 +- 0.008 versus 0.140 +- 0.003). On IPV-Bench, it achieves strong localisation performance with lower false-alarm rates than existing optimisation baselines. Together, these results show that searching over complete VLM harnesses can outperform existing evaluation strategies, transfer to an unseen video generator, and reduce false alarms on real videos.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何为 VLM 自动构造视频错误定位的执行流程：提出 Harness Search and Merge（HSM），在可执行评估程序空间中搜索「看哪些帧、调哪些工具与模型、如何合并预测」的 harness，由 LLM 编排器在随机子集上独立改进候选并以记忆合并互补方案，在 Spotlight 与 IPV-Bench 上优于手工策略与已有优化基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在完整推理流程上搜索并合并候选」的思路可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、工具/模型调用编排与多路预测聚合（近似 LOOK 与贡献分配）的设计空间，但原论文面向生成视频的错误定位，并非 latent 推理状态的生成或训练。
